name: log_spit_up
description: Log a spit-up in PoopJob. size describes how much came up. occurred_at is optional and defaults to now.

size.description: Required. One of: small, medium, large.

occurred_at.description: Optional. When the spit-up happened, as ISO 8601, for example "2026-01-12T08:30:00+02:00". A value without an offset is read in the configured timezone. Defaults to now.
